_about: A330-800, from Airbus AC A330 (Dec 01/25) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-800 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 66) and 2 (plan: page index 67). Pixels of layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill rasters, line centres: the side at scale 16 turned level (--rotate -0.46), the plan at 15.147 and the front at 16, as the A330-900's. The sheet draws the aircraft 1.4% shorter than its printed 58.82 m overall length while its height and width are drawn at the A330-900 sheet's scale (its other printed lengths, 47.09 m, 57.51 m and the plan's, are the A330-900's less 5.33 m, ten frames): the side and plan are stretched lengthwise by 1.01385 (--xscale) so the printed length and the printed 5.64 m height share one scale, 81.56 px a meter. The A330-900's points moved by the two plugs out (plug.py: 3.20 m ahead of door 2 and 2.39 m between door 3 and door 4 on the side, as the drawn doors show; 3.19 m and 2.14 m on the plan, as its printed figures), stretched as the sheet, the parts laid on by best fit, then snapped; the fin, the A330-200's taller one, is the A330-200's points laid on this sheet. Windows behind the wing's lines at the drawing's pitch; door 3 (a Type A, as the A330-200's) is drawn only above the wing: its height is the A330-900's.

sources.title: Airbus, A330 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Dec 01/25), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-800 sheets 1 and 2
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a338/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The A330-900's points moved by the two fuselage plugs out (plug.py) and snapped to this sheet; the fin is the A330-200's (8.80 m, against the A330-900's 8.30 m). The sheet draws the aircraft 1.4% shorter than its printed 58.82 m (it and its other printed lengths are the A330-900's less ten frames, 5.33 m, where the overall lengths differ by 4.84 m), at the A330-900 sheet's scale across: the side and plan are stretched lengthwise to the printed length, so the length and the printed 5.64 m height share one scale. The side view is turned level from the sheet's ground attitude (0.46°). Engine out from the centerline: half the printed 18.74 m between the engines.
